name: uv_async_init

ownership.argument: Producer of the async handle layout: it names the busy word, the callback slot and the pending queue node the module has to read.

provenance.source: Guards on loop+360 == -1, creates the pipe pair through 0xC2E1A60, stores the two descriptors at loop+360/+364, writes &loop->async_handles into handle+16, loop into handle+4, the callback into handle+96, clears handle+24, links handle+100 into the loop list at +312 through loop+316, and clears the pending word at handle+108.

notes: busy word 6 (handle+24), pending word 27 (handle+108), callback +96, pending queue node +100. q66 uses pending word 15, so this must not be inherited.
